traceability.notes:
All requirements and acceptance criteria in docs/stories/024.0-DEV-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE-REFS.story.md are fully implemented.
Backtick-wrapped content is stripped in the centralized normalizeCommentLine helper using a generic /`[^`]*`/g replacement that preserves character positions, satisfying REQ-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE, REQ-PRESERVE-BOUNDARIES, and REQ-CENTRALIZED-FILTER. The dedicated test suite in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format-internal.test.ts exercises documentation-style patterns (e.g., `@story`, `@req`, `@story` + `@req`, and mixed `@supports` inline code plus a real @story annotation), ensuring only real annotations are detected while inline-code references are ignored. The global Jest run passes, confirming no regressions, and the behavior is clearly documented in the normalizeCommentLine JSDoc and inline comments. Therefore this story is PASSED.
